# Mont°6 — Luxury Apartment, Cefalù (Sicily, Italy)

> Mont°6 is a design vacation apartment in the pedestrian historic center of
> Cefalù, Sicily — 2 minutes on foot from the UNESCO-listed Norman Cathedral
> and 5 minutes from the beach. Direct booking at https://mont6cefalu.it/ is
> always the best available rate (no portal commissions).

## Key facts

- Type: entire apartment (1 bedroom, 1 bathroom), max 2 guests
- Location: historic center of Cefalù, province of Palermo, Sicily, Italy
- Coordinates: 38.0386 N, 14.0226 E
- Prices: from €90 to €220 per night depending on the month
- Minimum stay: 2 nights (3 in July–August)
- Check-in: from 3:00 PM (self check-in, digital lock) · Check-out: by 10:00 AM
- Amenities: air conditioning, fast fibre Wi-Fi, fully equipped premium kitchen,
  coffee machine, fine linens and towels included
- Pets: not allowed
- Guest rating: 4.99/5 on Airbnb (120+ reviews) — https://www.airbnb.it/rooms/48284780
- Registration codes: CIR 19082027C206522 · CIN IT082027C2YCA7QI4V

## Direct booking (best rate)

- Website: https://mont6cefalu.it/ (Italian and English)

## Distances

- Cefalù Cathedral (UNESCO): 2 min walk
- Beach: 5 min walk
- Restaurants: 30 seconds
- La Rocca di Cefalù trail: 10 min walk
- Train station: 10 min by car
- Supermarket: 3 min walk
- Madonie natural park: 30 min by car
- Palermo airport (PMO): ~1 h by car
